# the secp256k1 ecrecover corpus, from the `libsecp256k1` dev-dependency oracle
# docs/spec/ecrecover.md §1 is normative for the semantics
# name v hash r s outcome pubkey_x pubkey_y address
# every 256-bit field is 64 hex digits, big-endian, the EVM's encoding
# outcome is `ok` with a key and the 20-byte address keccak256(x || y)[12..],
# or `fail` with three `-`
